publication_text: UK Contracts Finder, *RM6100 Technology Services 3 Agreement*, public contract attachment, 277 pages, page 24, KPI4 “Analytics & AI Solutions Effectiveness” and footnote 4. This page was checked against the official original on September 9, 2026. Interpret the KPI together with the SLA agreed for each solution; it does not support conclusions about other contract terms or actual performance.

UK Government Commercial Function, *Call Off Schedule Templates*, Call Off Schedule 6, service levels and performance monitoring section, checked September 6, 2026. This is a general template, not the teaching company's contract.

UK Government Commercial Function, *Risk Allocation and Pricing Approaches guidance note*, June 15, 2026 version, sections 2.1 and 4.1.2–4.1.4. Public procurement guidance on risk and control capability, used to explain management tradeoffs, not general legal rules for Chinese companies.
